scenario_1_chain.name: Linear Chain (A -> B -> C)
scenario_1_chain.description: Linear 3-machine cascade where A propagates to B with 60s delay, and B propagates to C with 90s delay across 6 periodic waves.

scenario_coexisting_consistent.name: Coexisting Dual - Delay Consistent (Direct A->C 90s == 40s + 50s)
scenario_coexisting_consistent.description: Dual-pathway scenario where A triggers B (40.0s), B triggers C (50.0s), and A also directly triggers C (90.0s). Both direct edge and multi-hop path are ground truth.

scenario_coexisting_inconsistent.name: Coexisting Dual - Delay Inconsistent (Direct A->C 30s != 40s + 50s)
scenario_coexisting_inconsistent.description: Dual-pathway scenario where A triggers B (40.0s), B triggers C (50.0s), and A also directly triggers C (30.0s). Both direct edge and multi-hop path are ground truth.

scenario_2_branching.name: Branching Fork (A -> B and A -> C)
scenario_2_branching.description: Single-source branching topology where machine A independently propagates to B (45s delay) and C (80s delay).

scenario_3_ring.name: Feedback Ring (A -> B -> C -> A)
scenario_3_ring.description: Cyclic feedback topology where A -> B -> C -> A propagates in closed loop with 50s delays per leg.

scenario_6_common_cause.name: Common Cause Disturbance (Shared Environmental Shock)
scenario_6_common_cause.description: Three machines responding near-simultaneously (<10s delta) to shared external disturbances. Evaluates whether OC-CCD flags common-cause candidates and avoids false propagation claims.

scenario_5_reversed_order.name: Reversed Temporal Order (Target Precedes Source)
scenario_5_reversed_order.description: Machines A and B where machine B consistently fires 60s before A. Evaluates whether A -> B is rejected by temporal direction gating.

scenario_7_noisy.name: Noisy Cascade (Jitter, Dropout, Spurious Events)
scenario_7_noisy.description: Cascade chain A -> B -> C with Gaussian delay jitter (std=6.0s), 15% observation dropout probability, and spurious noise events.
